title: Olink Target 48 Part 2/3: Extension
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the fields provided above the protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware files
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your labware definition files (.json) if required.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the Opentrons App (refer to the support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Start the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to execute the protocol.
